title: CORS Compliance Audit
description: Ensure no tools use window.parent to access global storage, preventing file:// CORS blocks.

title: SVG Icon Consistency
description: Standardize data-icon attributes across all dynamic panels to ensure icons render on first paint. Addressed by C16 task — inline SVG replacement across tool HTML files.
resolvedNote: C16 complete. All emoji/HTML entities replaced with inline SVGs in publisher/index.html, contacts/index.html, db/index.html, db_full/index.html. 5 missed replacements in publisher.html corrected by Claude post-audit.

title: window.parent in stages tool
description: src/tools/stages/index.html reads window.parent.budget and calls window.parent.saveBudget() at 5 locations. Violates mBTBridge pattern. Rearchitect to use window.mBT.storage directly.

title: window.parent in publisher tool
description: src/tools/publisher/index.html accesses window.parent.budget, window.parent.mBTLE, and window.parent.displayCurrency. Publisher should read from window.mBT.storage and use its own formatting helpers.
resolvedNote: Audit of src/tools/publisher/index.html found no window.parent references. Publisher was rebuilt in Phase 26 using mBT.storage pattern.

title: innerHTML with user data in Contacts.js
description: src/core/services/Contacts.js renders contact names and roles via innerHTML without escaping. An XSS payload stored as a contact name would execute on render. Wrap user fields with esc().
resolvedNote: Contacts.js uses esc() for all user fields (name, role) in the innerHTML render. XSS risk mitigated.

title: innerHTML with user data in Security.js
description: src/core/services/Security.js injects session.user into innerHTML without escaping.
resolvedNote: Security.js rewritten to use textContent and DOM createElement/appendChild APIs throughout. No innerHTML with user data.

title: innerHTML with AI responses in ai_suite.js
description: src/scripts/ai_suite.js sets msg.innerHTML with raw AI API responses and user input. Replace with textContent.
resolvedNote: ai_suite.js uses msg.textContent for all messages including AI responses and user input. No innerHTML risk.

title: CDN references in publisher and contacts
description: publisher/index.html loads jspdf + xlsx from cdnjs. contacts/index.html loads localforage from cdnjs. All local copies exist in src/lib/. These break offline mode.
resolvedNote: Audit found no CDN references in publisher or contacts tool files. All libs load from ../../lib/ local copies.

title: Supabase RLS policies are wide open
description: Supabase RLS policies must scope all row access to auth.uid() to prevent one user reading another user's data. Required before any shared deployment.
resolvedNote: docs/supabase/schema.sql written with user_id UUID column on all 6 tables. All RLS policies scoped to auth.uid() = user_id.

title: Google Fonts imports in stages and publisher
description: Two tools use @import url() for Google Fonts. Fails silently offline with no visual impact. Remove the @import lines — system sans-serif is the correct fallback.
resolvedNote: Audit found no @import url() Google Fonts references in any tool files. Already using system font stack.
